Spencer is prone to experiencing seasickness. This tendency is a recurring aspect of her experiences when traveling by water.

Seven years before bringing [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) over from [Hopetown](../codex/places.md#hopeton), Mrs. Spencer acquired the young orphan girl. ## Relationships

### [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

[Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) is Spencer's daughter. While Spencer manages household affairs and visitors at their home, [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) lives with her as part of the family dynamic. Her presence is established alongside Spencer's role in facilitating local arrangements and child placements in the community.
